9
An irregularly shaped metal plate is freely suspended from a point P and is in equilibrium, as
shown. Point Q is vertically below P.
P
Q
Which statement about the position of the centre of gravity of the metal plate is correct?
A
It is at P.
B
It is at Q.
C
It is halfway between P and Q.
D
Further investigation is needed to determine its position.

options.label: C
options.text: It is halfway between P and Q.

options.label: D
options.text: Further investigation is needed to determine its position.
